command: set -u; echo '===HOST==='; hostname; echo '===OMEGA_PROCESSES==='; pgrep -af 'omega\.(supervisor|grid_runtime|bridge_relay|spool_bridge_relay|outer_bridge_worker|telemetry_daemon|master_bridge)' || true; echo '===RUNTIME_DIRS==='; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime /home/ai-core-node/omega_runtime /home/ai-core-node/oMEGA; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; fi; done; echo '===OMEGA_SERVICES==='; systemctl --user --no-pager is-active omega-chatgpt-mcp.service omega-local-effect-adapter.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===SSH_HOST_ALIASES==='; if [ -r "$HOME/.ssh/config" ]; then awk '/^[[:space:]]*Host[[:space:]]+/ {for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if($i !~ /[*?!]/) print $i}' "$HOME/.ssh/config"; fi
